incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — SEV2: embedder-queue backlog surge in us-west1. Page sent to @Erin (oncall). Link: https://redwood.inc/pagers/1761123456
Erin (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Pulling logs and looking at traffic now.
Maya (sre): Logged. Does this correlate with the new batch window from yesterday's deploy?
Erin (oncall): Possibly. Initial signs: sustained enqueue growth starting 11:01 UTC, spike at 11:07. Error rate ~0.8% -> 12% latency increase for embeddings route. Affected tenants: ~13 (list in incident doc).
Jordan (sre): Mitigation moved: rolling back embedder config `batch_limit=64` -> `32` and increased worker pool +2. Monitoring KVs for backlog.
incident-bot: Deployment rollback completed (pipeline #7893) — no failures.
Erin (oncall): After rollback backlog draining, P95 latency down from 980ms -> 180ms over 12m. Continuing to observe.
Liz (product): Any customer-facing impact? Need ETA for credits or comms.
Erin (oncall): Customer-impact estimate: ~13 customers saw degraded embeddings; 4 had embedded failures >3% error rates. Window ~11:03-11:27 UTC. Suggest small credits for impacted customers; will confirm list.
Kevin (eng): I'll own the remediation ticket to prevent recurrence. Creating RED-4321 for root cause + durable fix (adaptive batch tuning + guardrails).
Kevin (eng): Preliminary sizing: investigation + immediate fix = 1d, tests + rollout = 2d, canary + monitoring = 1d => total 4d (2 engineers). Recommend mark S2 and prioritize in next reliability sprint.
Erin (oncall): Assigning RED-4321 -> Kevin, reviewer Jordan. I'll create follow-up for customer comms: RED-4322 -> Liz.
Ryan (ops): Add to Q2 reliability backlog as 'embedder adaptive batching' — suggest E2 (week) slot. PM approval needed.
Liz (product): Q2 tie-in ok from product. Need precise acceptance criteria: no >1% error spikes and automated fallback when backlog > threshold.
Jordan (sre): Action items summary:
• RED-4321 - root cause + adaptive tuning - owner Kevin - estimate 4d
• RED-4322 - customer comms + credits - owner Liz - estimate 0.5d
• RED-4323 - runbook update & alerts - owner Erin - estimate 1d
Please add to the action tracker.
Erin (oncall): Scheduling postmortem: Thu 16:00 PT (link calendar). Owner: Kevin. Draft due EOD Fri.
Kevin (eng): I'll run the postmortem. Taking notes and will propose tests.
Maya (sre): Please include the `embedder-backlog` runbook updates and thresholds. Link: https://redwood.inc/runbooks/embedder-backlog
Liz (product): I'll draft comms template after RED-4322 created.
Erin (oncall): Closing live mitigation. Monitoring for an hour. If stable, I'll mark page resolved. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Pager resolved by Erin at 11:41 UTC. Recording incident summary to incidents/1761123456.
Erin (oncall): Thanks team — tagging the action items for triage in sprint planning. :thumbsup:
